intent: Expose a least-authority read-only WineBot DLE/CI continuation to the existing Agent Dispatch Sidecar on Pandora. WineBot GitHub PRs/issues remain authoritative; this materialization is not a release, merge, workcell, or credential grant.

state.source_authority: SemperSupra/WineBot main and live pull requests own source, gates and decisions; reconcile exact current heads before using.
state.runtime_qualification: SemperSupra/WineBot PR #150 owns Wine 11 REL candidate, trace startup and resource qualification; nightly release gate is separate.
state.contract_qualification: SemperSupra/WineBot PR #123 owns vNext conformance, external pinned source, redaction and legacy-v1 gate.
state.application_qualification: SemperSupra/WineBot PRs #132 #133 #135 #143 #144 own CPU-renderer and Windows application RDTE; preserve independent workcells.
state.public_runner_policy: Only approved standard public GitHub-hosted Actions runners for automated WineBot qualification; no paid private hosted Actions minutes.

unknowns.final_wine11_acceptance: Wine 11 is not accepted until candidate container health, resource, conformance and release gates have source-bound receipts.
unknowns.observer_acceptance: Long-running Wine 11 observer, overflow/restart and Windows parity require real runtime acceptance.
unknowns.executor_binding: No WineBot-specific Pandora execution target, actuating admission or assignment is implied by observation permission.

responsibilities: Reconcile exact WineBot main and active PR heads from GitHub rather than conversation state.
Read public CI statuses and sanitized source-bound results; distinguish transport green from semantic acceptance.
Produce an owner-readable frontier and next batons without mutating WineBot or Pandora.

constraints: Treat GitHub project-native DLE as authority, not this workset or ChatGPT conversation.
No active GH workflow dispatch or sidecar workcell actuation in this observation delegation.
Never publish host identifiers, private endpoints, credentials, raw logs, or protected traces.
Preserve fail-closed public-runner policy and exactly tracked source/receipt identity.
An MCP transport grant cannot override any WineBot decision or release gate.

criteria: Pandora recognizes existing openai-tunnel caller for only this exact workset and delegation with observe caller class.
get_work_projection succeeds read-only and has no write/dispatch scope.
Existing unrelated Pandora grants and bearer credentials remain unchanged.
No workflow launched, repository mutated or protected data disclosed during observation qualification.

winebot-observe.frontier: Create the workset via reviewed project-native PR, then append exact read-only Pandora caller grant through the already installed trusted-host helper. After that, call get_work_projection on Pandora and record the observed receipt.
